caseNameFull: McReynolds v. Christenberry, Postmaster of New York City
attorneys: Nanette Dembitz and Melvin L. Wulf for petitioners. Solicitor General Cox for respondents.
judges: Black, Consideration, Down, Granted, Immediately, Postmaster, Should, Took

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted and the case, set down for oral argument immediately following Lamont V. Postmaster General, No. 491. Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
